appDescription: Finds second-hand items for sale near the driver's route and lets the driver stop by after the seller accepts. Voice functions: add an interest, answer the current stop-by question, and ask anything about the listings on the route (condition, price, detour, comparison, picking one).

function.name: ADD_INTEREST
function.description: Adds a keyword the driver wants to buy to the interest list so matching listings near the route are announced.

keyword.description: Item the driver wants, such as a stroller or a camping chair.

goLevel.description: How far the driver is willing to detour for it.

function.name: ANSWER_ALERT
function.description: Answers the stop-by question currently shown on screen: yes or no, or the item name when two items are offered.

item.description: Item name to choose when the app asks which of two items to stop by for.

function.name: ASK_ABOUT_LISTINGS
function.description: Asks the app about the second-hand listings along the current route in the driver's own words, such as what is available, the condition or price of an item, how far the detour is, which of two is better, or picking one. The app answers aloud in Korean.

question.description: The driver's question or instruction about the listings, in their own words.
